fields.service: Submit a BIR New Business Registration Application (Head Office or Branch)
fields.description: Submit a BIR new-business registration application for a head office or branch.
fields.scope: BIR tax registration is separate from DTI business-name registration; requirements depend on taxpayer and business type.

fields.service: File a Consumer Complaint with DTI (Metro Manila Online Filing)
fields.description: Submit and follow up a consumer complaint through DTI Consumer CARe.
fields.scope: The cited online filing route is for Metro Manila; consumers elsewhere should follow the relevant DTI regional procedure.

fields.service: Request Business or Investment Assistance from BOI-OWN
fields.description: Access BOI-OWN business and investment assistance information.
fields.scope: This is an assistance portal, not a substitute for specialist registrations, permits, or local government approvals.

fields.service: Submit SEC General Information Sheet (GIS) or Audited Financial Statements (AFS) through eFAST
fields.description: File covered corporate GIS and AFS submissions through SEC eFAST.
fields.scope: Requires corporate enrollment/account access and eSECURE linkage; eFAST coverage depends on entity and report type.

fields.service: Find How to Update DTI Business Name Registration Information
fields.description: Read DTI BNRS instructions for correcting or updating business-name registration information.
fields.scope: This is guidance, not a self-service update form. Some address and owner-name changes require an in-person DTI office visit; confirm the location and checklist with DTI.

fields.service: Apply for a New Motor Vehicle Certificate of Conformity (COC)
fields.description: Apply for an EMB Certificate of Conformity for eligible new motor-vehicle types.
fields.scope: Not a general product-conformity certificate. Eligible applicant and vehicle types are limited; company registration/account linkage is required.

fields.service: Apply for PDEA Certification for Non-Controlled Chemicals or a Certificate of Exemption
fields.description: Apply through PDEA OACEIS for the specified non-controlled-chemical certifications or exemption certificates.
fields.scope: The verified transfer covers specified certifications/exemptions only; it does not establish that controlled-chemical permits moved to OACEIS.

fields.service: Apply for an ERC Certificate of Compliance through EVOSS
fields.description: Start the applicable Certificate of Compliance filing in the EVOSS proponent portal.
fields.scope: Published EVOSS workflows specifically describe GenCo and MGSP; process and availability vary by facility and applicant, and a project must be associated with the company.

fields.service: Apply for PEZA Registration as an Ecozone Enterprise or Ecozone Developer via BERMS
fields.description: Access PEZA’s registration platform, where BERMS handles covered ecozone enterprise/developer applications.
fields.scope: PEZA Circular 2025-021 describes BERMS Phase 1 for specified new and expansion projects, not every PEZA application; account or migration steps may apply.

fields.service: Register or Update BIR Taxpayer Information Online (ORUS)
fields.description: Use ORUS for the taxpayer registration and information-update transactions currently supported for your taxpayer type.
fields.scope: Available transactions and account requirements depend on taxpayer type and current BIR portal rules; distinct from NewBizReg and DTI BNRS.

fields.service: Apply for a Postal ID in Person
fields.description: Review PHLPost’s current Postal ID requirements and application form before applying.
fields.scope: Application is made in person; this is not an online issuance service.

fields.service: Apply for a Solo Parent ID through your City or Municipal Social Welfare Office
fields.agency: Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD)
fields.description: Read DSWD guidance for applying for a Solo Parent ID through the local social welfare office.
fields.scope: The application is handled by the city/municipal LGU, not through a single national online transaction.

fields.service: View your GSIS Membership Record through GSIS Touch
fields.description: Find the official GSIS Touch app route for checking membership records.
fields.scope: The cited page describes an app-based member service; account access and app availability apply.

fields.service: Submit SSS Loans Collection List and Remit Loan Payments
fields.description: Submit employee SSS loan collection information and handle employer loan remittance.
fields.scope: For registered SSS employers; employer account access is required.

fields.description: Report employee premiums and remit employer contributions using PhilHealth EPRS.
fields.scope: EPRS is for employers and is distinct from PhilHealth member self-service.

fields.service: Find TESDA Scholarship Programs and Application Requirements
fields.agency: Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA)
fields.description: Review official TESDA scholarship information and follow the application instructions for a specific program.
fields.scope: Scholarship availability and application windows vary by program and cycle; this is separate from TESDA Online Program enrollment.

fields.service: Verify Registered Enterprise-Based Unions
fields.agency: Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE), Bureau of Labor Relations
fields.description: Check DOLE’s enterprise-based union verification service.
fields.scope: Verification only; this is not union registration.

fields.service: Apply for Union or Workers’ Association Registration Online
fields.agency: Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE), Bureau of Labor Relations
fields.description: Start a union or workers’ association registration request through DOLE’s OURS portal.
fields.scope: Original documents may still be required; confirm the current requirements with DOLE.

fields.service: Download PRC Oath Form (Legacy PDF; Check Current Instructions)
fields.description: This older PDF contains in-person instructions and is not a current online licensing transaction.
fields.scope: Check the current PRC Online Services page for active examination and initial-registration procedures.

fields.service: View DSWD Disaster Situation Reports (DROMIC)
fields.agency: Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD)
fields.description: View DSWD Disaster Response Operations Monitoring and Information Center reports.
fields.scope: Information and monitoring only; this is not a preparedness application or emergency dispatch service.

fields.service: View Real-Time Rainfall and Water-Level Monitoring via PhilSensors
fields.agency: Department of Science and Technology – Advanced Science and Technology Institute (DOST-ASTI)
fields.description: View rainfall and water-level monitoring stations and observations on PhilSensors.
fields.scope: Monitoring information is not a substitute for official emergency warnings or local instructions.

fields.service: Assess Flood, Landslide, and Storm-Surge Hazards with UP NOAH
fields.agency: University of the Philippines (UP) Nationwide Operational Assessment of Hazards (NOAH)
fields.description: Explore UP NOAH hazard assessment information for flood, landslide, and storm-surge risks.
fields.scope: Do not treat beta weather information as an operational warning or emergency alert.

fields.service: Read about the OLTrap Dengue Early-Warning Project
fields.agency: Philippine Council for Health Research and Development (PCHRD)
fields.description: Read about a specific IoT-based OL Trap and community dengue early-warning project.
fields.scope: This is project information, not a general dengue information service or a confirmed nationwide public transaction.

fields.service: Search the Philippine Health Research Registry
fields.description: Search registered Philippine health research studies using the current registry portal.
fields.scope: Study registration is distinct from ethics clearance and proposal submission.

fields.service: Apply for PCSO Medical Assistance Program (MAP) Online
fields.description: Submit an application through PCSO’s current Online MAP service.
fields.scope: Assistance is subject to PCSO program requirements and review; the older OLAPP appointment page is not the application route.

fields.service: Submit a Grievance, Inquiry, Assistance Request, or Feedback to DSWD
fields.agency: Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD)
fields.description: Use DSWD IGRMS for grievances, inquiries, assistance requests, and feedback.
fields.scope: The system is broader than disaster-initiative complaints; response handling depends on the issue and responsible office.

fields.service: Learn about DBP WATER Infrastructure Project Financing
fields.description: Review DBP’s Water for Every Resident (WATER) Program for water-infrastructure project financing.
fields.scope: Institutional/project financing information, not individual household assistance.

fields.service: Read NACC Adoption Application Steps
fields.description: Read NACC guidance on the steps for prospective adoptive parents.
fields.scope: This source describes adoption steps; it does not verify an online expression-of-interest or foster application.

fields.service: Learn about SSS Retirement Benefits (Technical Retirement)
fields.description: Review SSS retirement benefit information relevant to the technical-retirement service record.
fields.scope: The page is benefit guidance; use My.SSS or SSS instructions for the applicable transaction.

fields.service: File and Pay Taxes Online through eFPS
fields.description: File and pay taxes online through BIR eFPS when your taxpayer and return are eligible for that system.
fields.scope: eFPS is not the universal filing route; some taxpayers use eBIRForms or other BIR eServices.

fields.service: Apply for a BIR Tax Clearance Certificate through eTCS
fields.description: Use eTCS to apply for eligible BIR tax-clearance certificates.
fields.scope: Eligibility and exclusions depend on the clearance purpose; bidding-purpose clearance uses a separate eTCBP-TCVC route.

fields.service: Find the LTO Driver’s License Renewal Process (eGovPH)
fields.description: Read LTO’s instructions for driver’s-license renewal through the eGovPH app.
fields.scope: The link is guidance, not a renewal form; actual workflow, eligibility, and required steps are handled through eGovPH/LTO.

fields.service: Convert a Foreign Driver’s License in the Philippines
fields.description: Start by reviewing LTO’s current foreign-license conversion requirements and LTMS portal.
fields.scope: Do not assume the conversion is wholly online; supporting documents and an LTO office visit may be required.

fields.service: Check MMDA Traffic Violations by Plate Number
fields.description: Check whether a vehicle has an MMDA traffic violation and access related adjudication steps.
fields.scope: Use the linked MMDA vehicle portal; payment and e-contest are separate steps within the system.

fields.service: Pay a Pag-IBIG Calamity Loan Online
fields.description: Pay an existing Pag-IBIG calamity loan through Virtual Pag-IBIG.
fields.scope: Payment only; this is not an application for a new calamity loan.

fields.service: Pay a Pag-IBIG Multi-Purpose Loan Online
fields.description: Pay an existing Pag-IBIG Multi-Purpose Loan through Virtual Pag-IBIG.
fields.scope: Payment only; this is not a loan application.

fields.service: Pay Pag-IBIG MP2 Voluntary Savings Online
fields.description: Remit Pag-IBIG MP2 voluntary savings through Virtual Pag-IBIG.
fields.scope: Savings contribution/payment, not a housing-loan payment.

fields.service: Pay Pag-IBIG Regular Savings Contributions Online
fields.description: Pay mandatory Pag-IBIG regular savings contributions through Virtual Pag-IBIG.
fields.scope: Member savings/contribution payment, not a housing-loan payment.

fields.service: Learn about the DBP Digital Banking Portal
fields.description: Read about DBP’s Digital Banking Portal and how an eligible customer can access it.
fields.scope: This page is not itself a verified sign-in destination.

fields.service: View requirements for Accredited Official of Foreign Government Visa (9E)
fields.description: Review the Bureau of Immigration’s requirements for an Accredited Official of a Foreign Government Visa (9E).
fields.scope: The linked page provides visa information, not a verified online application transaction. Use BI’s current instructions for application steps.

additions.service: Register a Corporation or Partnership Online through SEC eSPARC
additions.description: Start an SEC eSPARC application to register a domestic corporation or partnership.
additions.scope: Domestic entity registration and foreign-corporation licensing follow different processes; requirements vary by entity type.

additions.service: Find Business Registration Services through the Philippine Business Hub
additions.description: Use PBH to find and start relevant national business-registration services.
additions.scope: A discovery/access portal, not a replacement for specialist agency transactions or a universal LGU permit application.

additions.service: File SEC Corporate or Partnership Amendments through eAMEND
additions.description: Submit covered domestic corporation and partnership amendments through SEC eAMEND.
additions.scope: Requires eSECURE access; only specified entity types and amendment categories are covered. Foreign-corporation license changes are outside stated coverage.

additions.service: File a Beneficial Ownership Declaration through SEC HARBOR
additions.description: Submit covered beneficial-ownership declarations through SEC HARBOR.
additions.scope: Requires eSECURE access; entity coverage and responsible filer depend on entity type and reportorial requirements.

additions.service: Register a Non-CSF Cooperative Online through CDA e-CoopRIS
additions.description: Start the online registration process for a non-Credit Surety Fund (non-CSF) cooperative.
additions.scope: CSF cooperative procedures are separate; the cited process includes hard-copy steps after online approval. Confirm current CDA instructions.

additions.service: Submit Cooperative Annual Compliance Reports and Apply for a Certificate of Compliance (CAIS)
additions.description: Submit cooperative compliance reports and apply for a Certificate of Compliance through CDA CAIS.
additions.scope: Required reports depend on cooperative type/status. Availability and reporting years can vary; verify current instructions with CDA.

additions.service: Register as a PhilGEPS Supplier
additions.description: Create a merchant account and register as a supplier in PhilGEPS.
additions.scope: Registration tiers have different requirements and fees; this does not guarantee eligibility for every procurement or mean all bids are submitted online.

additions.service: Search Public PhilGEPS Procurement Opportunities
additions.description: Browse published government procurement opportunities on PhilGEPS.
additions.scope: Opportunity search is distinct from supplier registration; each tender sets its own eligibility, documents, and bid-submission route.

additions.service: Apply for DTI-BPS PS Product Certification License or Import Commodity Clearance (ICC)
additions.agency: Department of Trade and Industry – Bureau of Philippine Standards (DTI-BPS)
additions.description: Use PCIMS to apply for a Philippine Standard (PS) certification license or an Import Commodity Clearance.
additions.scope: PS and ICC have different requirements; ICC applies according to the current mandatory-certification list, and account/document review steps apply.

additions.service: Apply for IPOPHL Copyright Registration or Deposit
additions.agency: Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines (IPOPHL)
additions.description: Follow IPOPHL instructions to file a single-work application through CORDS or use the limited bulk-submission route.
additions.scope: The linked page is a guide, not the form itself. Registration/deposit is voluntary; copyright protection arises automatically on creation. Bulk filing has specific limits.

additions.service: Apply Online for an EMB Environmental Compliance Certificate (ECC)
additions.description: Start an online ECC application for projects covered by the current EMB process.
additions.scope: Eligibility, project screening, exclusions, and regional rules apply; some project types must use another process.

additions.service: Apply Online for an EMB Certificate of Non-Coverage (CNC)
additions.description: Use the EMB CNC portal to request a Certificate of Non-Coverage for a qualifying project.
additions.scope: Online CNC coverage is limited to qualifying Category D projects under specified conditions; screening and regional rules apply.

additions.service: Apply for BFAR SPS Import Clearance for Covered Wet-Market Fishery Products
additions.agency: Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR)
additions.description: Access the DA InterCommerce route for the covered sanitary and phytosanitary import-clearance process.
additions.scope: The cited Citizen’s Charter describes a narrow service for PFDA-accredited importers using an InterCommerce account; not all BFAR import/export permits.

additions.service: Apply for an SB Corp RISE UP Multi-Purpose Loan
additions.description: Check the SB Corp portal for the current RISE UP Multi-Purpose Loan application route.
additions.scope: Eligibility, terms, rates, loan limits, and fund availability may change; confirm current details with SB Corp before applying.

additions.service: Pay SSS Contributions Online
additions.description: Review SSS contribution payment options and continue through an authorized payment channel or My.SSS.
additions.scope: The guidance page is not itself a payment processor; payment methods and applicable schedules depend on member type.

additions.service: Access PhilHealth Member Records and Self-Service
additions.description: Access member information and available PhilHealth self-service functions, including records and contribution information.
additions.scope: Member portal only; employer premium reporting is handled separately through EPRS. Available tasks depend on account access.

additions.service: Find National Emergency and Disaster-Response Hotlines
additions.agency: eGovPH / Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT)
additions.description: Find government emergency and disaster-response contact numbers.
additions.scope: A contact directory, not incident dispatch or case filing; check the listed agency channel before relying on it.

additions.service: Check PAGASA Flood Information and River-Basin Status
additions.agency: Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA)
additions.description: Review PAGASA flood information and river-basin monitoring updates.
additions.scope: Monitoring information; follow current PAGASA advisories and local emergency instructions.

additions.service: Apply for TESDA Competency Assessment and National Certificate or Certificate of Competency
additions.agency: Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA)
additions.description: Review TESDA’s competency-assessment procedure and find the appropriate assessment route.
additions.scope: Assessment is not wholly online; schedule, fees, and requirements depend on the qualification and accredited assessment center.

additions.service: Search Jobs and Create a Jobseeker Account on PhilJobNet
additions.description: Search job vacancies and create a jobseeker profile on the PhilJobNet platform.
additions.scope: Free job matching/search; hiring decisions and vacancy availability are controlled by employers.

additions.service: File and Track a DOLE SEnA Request for Assistance
additions.description: Submit and track a Request for Assistance under DOLE’s Single Entry Approach (SEnA).
additions.scope: Case handling and eligibility follow DOLE rules; electronic filing does not guarantee resolution online.

additions.service: Create or Update a DMW e-Registration Profile for Overseas Employment
additions.description: Create or update a DMW e-Registration profile used for applicable overseas-employment services.
additions.scope: The profile is only one step in overseas employment processes; requirements vary by worker, agency, and service.

additions.service: Apply for a PRC Licensure Examination or Initial Professional Registration Online
additions.description: Access PRC Online Services for covered licensure examination applications and initial professional registration.
additions.scope: Different professions and transaction types have distinct schedules, documentary requirements, and eligibility rules.

additions.service: Register for the Expanded 4PH Socialized-Housing Program
additions.agency: Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development (DHSUD) / Pag-IBIG Fund
additions.description: Register interest in the Expanded Pambansang Pabahay para sa Pilipino (4PH) program through the Pag-IBIG route.
additions.scope: Registration is not a housing-loan approval or guarantee of a unit; project availability, eligibility, and financing conditions apply.

additions.service: Apply for a Pag-IBIG Short-Term Loan for Home Improvement
additions.description: Review Pag-IBIG’s home-improvement loan requirements and application procedure.
additions.scope: The cited guide describes a branch-submitted application, not an online loan filing; eligibility and loan terms apply.

additions.service: View and Buy Pag-IBIG Acquired Assets (Foreclosed Properties)
additions.description: Browse Pag-IBIG acquired assets and review the current purchase or bidding instructions.
additions.scope: This page provides inventory/instructions, not itself a bid submission; property listings and sale conditions change.

additions.service: Apply through the SHFC Community Mortgage Program
additions.description: Review how an eligible community association can proceed with the Community Mortgage Program.
additions.scope: Community/association-based process, not an individual online application; eligibility and project steps apply.

additions.service: Register or Update a Philippine eTravel Declaration
additions.description: Complete or update the eTravel declaration before covered travel.
additions.scope: The official FAQ states registration is free; covered travelers should register/update within the allowed pre-departure window and check current rules.

additions.service: Apply for a Tourist Visa Extension Online
additions.description: Use BI eServices to apply for an eligible tourist visa extension.
additions.scope: Eligibility, stay conditions, and account requirements apply; check BI instructions for the traveler’s status.

additions.service: Apply for an Emigration Clearance Certificate (ECC-B)
additions.description: Apply online for ECC-B through BI eServices when eligible.
additions.scope: The online route is for eligible foreign ACR I-Card holders temporarily departing the Philippines; other travelers may use a different ECC process.

additions.agency: Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD)
additions.description: Read about the 4Ps program and its eligibility and implementation.

additions.description: Review Social Pension for Indigent Senior Citizens eligibility and how to ask about local access.
additions.scope: Information/referral, not a national online application; local validation and program rules apply.

additions.description: Use BIR eBIRForms for covered return preparation and filing.
additions.scope: A separate route from eFPS; return eligibility and filing/payment requirements vary by taxpayer.

additions.service: Calculate Withholding Tax Using the BIR Calculator
additions.description: Estimate withholding tax using BIR’s online calculator.

additions.service: Apply for Electronic Tax Clearance for Bidding Purposes (eTCBP-TCVC)
additions.description: Use the dedicated eTCBP-TCVC route for bidding-purpose tax clearance and tax compliance verification.

additions.service: Renew Motor-Vehicle Registration through LTO Online Services
additions.description: Start from the official LTMS portal and review LTO motor-vehicle registration requirements.
